A tip-off about Georgine, a "Goddess of Chaos" who revels in mayhem, hastens the purge. Meanwhile, Rozemyne, now a third-year student at the Royal Academy, is busy trying to shake off her sense of loss. In the dormitory, she persuades the children of Veronica's former faction to avoid being implicated, while the first day of classes for lord candidates begins at the academy. With exams for the civil service course, an encounter with a new senior librarian, and a major in the specialized course, she plunges into a life of drastic change in both her position and her environment from a year ago. As she gradually regains her "self," and even receives the blessings of the gods, Rozemyne's rampage becomes even more unstoppable! "Spread my book-loving virus to everyone!" (Source: Corona EX, translated)

title: Himuro no Tenchi: Fate/school Life
titleNative: 氷室の天地 Fate/school life
synopsis: Fate/school life is a comedy 4-koma manga revolving around the normal life at school of the minor characters of Fate/stay night and Fate/Hollow Ataraxia, specifically the character Himuro Kane, classmate of Fate/stay night protagonist Emiya Shirou. This manga by Mashin Eiichirou is a spin-off that tells the normal school life of the supporting characters Himuro Kane, Makidera Kaede, Saegusa Yukika. Other characters are the regular cast of the main games: Mitsuzuri Ayako, Tohsaka Rin, Ryuudou Issei, Matou Shinji, Emiya Shirou, Kuzuki Souichirou, Fujimura Taiga, Matou Sakura, Mitsuzuri Minori; "guest" characters from other series Ciel, Seven, Sajyou Ayaka (formerly the heroine of the never finished prototype novel of Fate/stay night) are also featured, and other classmates Gotou Gai, Fujimoto, Dezaki, Hirumata. The story is centered around classic school events such as a ball game tournament, field trips and inter high school competitions. As such, there is no reference at all to supernatural things like magecraft and Heroic Spirits. br> Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

title: Gisou Kareshi ni Aisarete Shimaimashita
titleNative: 偽装カレシに愛されてしまいました
synopsis: "Next time, please listen to my request." On the night of her 32nd birthday, female doctor Megumi is dumped by her boyfriend of seven years, who tells her, "I've found someone else I want to protect." He's cheating on her... and breaking up with her...! What's more, she's invited to her engagement party by the thief-like woman, Kurumi (she knows it!!). In a desperate situation, Megumi asks Akiho, a young doctor with an enlightened personality, to pretend to be her boyfriend, in order to get back at the two men. However, Akiho didn't agree to be her fake boyfriend out of goodwill, as she has another plan...!? "Surely this can't be the end," Akiho says with a serious face. What is her "request"...?! What is happiness for a woman?! A turbulent love comedy dedicated to independent women begins!! (Source : Mecha Comic, translated)

synopsis: In her previous life, she was an overworked office lady trapped in a black company. Now, she’s been reincarnated as Seraphina, the villainess of an otome game! Determined to avoid her doom and enjoy endless naps, she sets out to live a slow, carefree life… but for some reason, everyone around her starts to grow fond of her instead!?
